turns.text: Hi, I need to move my boiler service on Thursday, something came up.
Sure, I can help. Could you give me your customer ID and postcode?
C-1042, postcode 92000
Thanks. I see a visit on Thursday 23 October at 09:00. When would suit you?
Any morning next week, mornings only please.
I have Tuesday 28 October at 09:00. Shall I book it?
Yes please.
Done: your visit is moved to Tuesday 28 October at 09:00.
Why was I charged twice this month?? Invoice INV-20931 and INV-20932 are the same
I'm sorry about that. Can you confirm your customer ID?
I can see two identical charges of 89.00 EUR. I've refunded the duplicate; it will show in 3-5 days.
ok thanks
Acme Maintenance, how can I help?
Hello, I smell gas in my kitchen, I'm really worried.
Please leave the property now and don't use any switches. I'm connecting you to our emergency team.
Okay, I'm going outside. My address is 14 Rue des Lilas.
Thank you. A technician is being dispatched to 14 Rue des Lilas.

Hello,
Could you send me a copy of my last invoice? My account is C-3307.
Thanks, Marie

Dear Marie,
Please find invoice INV-30410 attached.
Kind regards
I want to cancel my maintenance contract
I'm sorry to hear that. May I ask why, and could you share your customer ID?
Moving abroad. ID is C-4410
Understood. Your contract will end on 30 November. You'll get a confirmation email.
hi my radiator is leaking, can someone come today?
Let's get that sorted. What's your postcode?
Our earliest slot in 75011 is tomorrow at 14:00. Would that work?
tomorrow is fine I guess
Booked for tomorrow 14:00. Please put a towel under the leak meanwhile.
Hello, I'd like to update my phone number
Of course. Your customer ID and the new number please?
C-5120 and the new number is 06 12 34 56 78
Updated. We'll use 06 12 34 56 78 from now on.
Acme Maintenance, good morning.
Morning. The technician didn't show up yesterday, I waited all afternoon.
I'm very sorry. Could you give me your customer number?
I see the missed visit. I can offer Friday at 10:00 and waive the call-out fee.
Fine, Friday at 10.
Booked for Friday 10:00, fee waived.
How much does an annual boiler service cost?
Our annual boiler service is 129 EUR including parts under 20 EUR.
ok and is there a discount for over 65s?
Yes, 10% off for customers over 65.
Great thanks
I paid my invoice INV-40022 by transfer but it still shows unpaid
Let me check. I can't find the payment yet. Could you share the transfer date?
12 October
Transfers can take up to 5 business days. I've flagged it for the billing team.
this is ridiculous, it's been over a week
I understand. The billing team will contact you within 24 hours.

Hi,
I'd like to add my partner as a second contact on the account C-7714. Her name is Sofia Reyes, email sofia.reyes@example.com.
Best

Hello,
Sofia Reyes has been added as a secondary contact.
Regards
Hi, I need a refund for the visit on the 3rd, the technician couldn't fix anything
Sorry to hear that. What's your customer ID?
I've opened a case; refunds for unresolved visits need a supervisor's approval. You'll hear back within 2 days.
Can't you just do it now?
I'm afraid not, but I've marked it as urgent.
Acme Maintenance, how can I help?
Yeah hi, my heating's not coming on at all. It's freezing.
Sorry about that. Is the boiler display showing an error code?
It says F28.
F28 is an ignition fault. Try pressing reset once. Did that help?
No, still F28.
Then we need a technician. Your postcode please?
I've booked an urgent visit tomorrow at 08:00.
Can I move my appointment from Monday to Wednesday afternoon?
Sure, customer ID please?
Wednesday afternoon is fully booked. Thursday at 15:00 is free.
No, I can only do Wednesday. Never mind then.
Understood, your Monday appointment stays as it is.
Do you install heat pumps?
Yes, we install air-to-water heat pumps. Would you like a free quote visit?
Yes. I'm at 33000 Bordeaux, house of about 120 m2
A surveyor can visit on 5 November at 11:00. Shall I book it?
Perfect
Booked. You'll receive a confirmation by SMS.

Hello,
Your technician scratched my kitchen floor during the visit on 14/10. Customer C-1550. I want compensation.
Regards, J. Okafor

Dear Mr Okafor,
We are sorry. A claims handler will contact you within 3 working days.
Kind regards
Thank you, I'll wait for the call.
is my contract auto-renewing?
Let me check, what's your customer ID?
Yes, it renews on 1 January. Would you like to turn off auto-renewal?
yes turn it off
Done, auto-renewal is off.
Acme Maintenance, hello.
Hi, I'm calling about the water heater install quote, reference Q-7781.
Thanks. The quote is 1,450 EUR installed. Would you like to accept it?
That's more than I expected. Can you do better?
I can apply our autumn offer: 1,300 EUR.
Okay, let's go with that.
Accepted at 1,300 EUR. We'll call to schedule the install.
I keep getting emails from you, how do I stop them?
I can unsubscribe you from marketing emails. Which address do they go to?
lena.k@example.org
Done, lena.k@example.org is unsubscribed from marketing emails. Service emails will continue.
hello? anyone there
Hello! How can I help you today?
my thermostat display is blank since this morning, account C-3390
Have you tried replacing the batteries?
it's wired, no batteries
Have you tried replacing the batteries?
you already asked that. forget it
